description: Labelled retrieval eval set for the JARVIS demo corpus. Positives pair a realistic query with the source_id that should be retrieved; negatives are off-topic queries the retriever should abstain on. Thresholds live in app/rag/evaluate.py and gate CI.

positives.query: how does the three layer query routing work
when does jarvis escalate to sonnet instead of haiku
what does the event store record and what does it leave out
how is personal data minimised in the logs
where is jarvis deployed and what runs the container
what gunicorn flask railway docker runtime is used
how are the unit integration and evaluation tests organised
how are the google and anthropic boundaries mocked in tests
why is retrieval built as one core with two adapters
how is cosine similarity search stored in sqlite with numpy
how is retrieval quality measured with recall and mrr
what is the false answer rate gate in continuous integration
how does the confidence threshold decide to abstain
what is the i don't know path when no good match exists
how do permission tags enforce least privilege on chunks
what read only scopes does drive indexing use
how do versioned collections make reindexing safe to roll back
how does promoting a new index with a pointer flip work
how is the retrieval core exposed as an mcp server tool
what model context protocol search tool is provided
how do environment variable feature flags gate capabilities
how is the retrieval feature flag turned on or off

negatives.query: what is the capital of france
recipe for banana bread with walnuts
best running shoes for a marathon in 2026
who won the world cup final
how do i change a flat tyre on a car
lyrics to a popular pop song
